vb_textbox.text: hi the aim of the game is to choose a knome out of 2 knomes one on the left and one on the right. To choose the left one press the s key then space and to choose the right one press the k key after choosing which knome and pressing s or k then space a basket will appear in which to collect mushrooms. To do this you need to press the space key. You only have 1.5 seconds to collect the mushrooms before it tells you too slow. so to clarify its s and space then space when basket appears or k then space then space when basket appears. Keep fingers on s and k and space as time goes really quick. Good luck!
